date_note: Date is Canon Marketing Japan's notice of 20 November; the notice says the unauthorized access to KARTE happened on 13 November.
title: Canon Marketing Japan says customer records may have leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
summary: Canon Marketing Japan said on 20 November that, based on a report from PLAID, customer information (the notice gives the count as 約366万件) may have leaked after a third party gained unauthorized access to PLAID's KARTE on 13 November. It says its own systems were not accessed. It says the data includes member ID, prefecture, city, postal code, age, date of birth, gender and mail-magazine subscription status, and not names, phone numbers or email addresses.
plain: Canon Marketing Japan says customer records (約366万件 in its notice) may have leaked from its contractor PLAID's KARTE service. It says names, phone numbers and email addresses were not included.
exec: Customer records (約366万件 in Canon Marketing Japan's notice) may have leaked through a vendor's marketing tool.
action: Canon Marketing Japan advises customers not to open URLs or enter personal information in suspicious emails, SMS messages or calls that may impersonate Canon or affiliated companies.

evidence.quote: 2026年11月13日（金）、プレイド社の「KARTE」に対して第三者による不正アクセスが発生し

validation.note: Canon Marketing Japan's own notice read; it says no misuse has been confirmed as of 20 November. A second page (Rocket Boys) agrees but carries a future date and is not cited.

review.note: Compared title, 20 Nov date, 13 Nov access, 約366万件 figure, data items, own-systems denial, no-misuse and customer advice against Canon's notice
